verdict.headline: Hormuz deal targeted today; AMD and SpaceX selloffs stay stock-specific as sole 30Y breach holds
verdict.label: ES +0.25% PM; SPX record 7,737 close; WTI $75.40 (-5.7%); 30Y 5.20% sole breach; ADP 8:15 AM ET; September hike ~54%
verdict.rationale_short: Tuesday delivered the bull case in sequence: oil cleared $79, September hike fell to ~54%, and PLTR's Monday beat carried the full session to a record SPX close of 7,737. AMD's $6.7B data-center quarter (+107% YoY) and SPCX's $7.81B revenue (+92% YoY) both beat every consensus line — and both sold off 8-10% after hours. NQ futures flat at the premarket open confirms the reactions as entry-driven, not thesis-breaking. The regime sits at 1-of-6 breaches: the 30Y at 5.20% is the last open trigger. ADP at 8:15 AM ET (consensus ~100K; June 98K) and a Hormuz interim announcement targeted for today are the two catalysts that set Wednesday's direction. If SPX closes below 7,380, this read no longer holds.

trade_setups.asset: Hormuz interim deal — oil deflation and energy re-rate
trade_setups.thesis: WTI $75.40 has priced significant Hormuz progress but not a formal signing. A 60-day interim announcement today (Bessent: 'today or tomorrow'; Iran approval completed) opens the next leg toward $68-70 as Persian Gulf supply progressively restores. Airlines, consumer discretionary, and logistics are the transmission vehicles. Energy producers face structural headwinds until OPEC+ supply response. The deal resets at each 60-day extension; it is not a permanent supply unlock.
trade_setups.entry: The levels: WTI $79 is where the oil-side regime breach returns. Below $72, the market has fully priced supply restoration. Formal signing is the first confirmation; first tanker transit within 48 hours is the operational confirmation.
trade_setups.invalidation: IRGC military action or Trump escalation rhetoric restores WTI $82+ in one session, returning both oil-side regime triggers immediately. The deal has collapsed twice in 2026.
trade_setups.horizon: Formal signing: today or Thursday. First tanker transit: 2-5 days post-signing.

trade_setups.thesis: 30Y at 5.20% is the sole regime breach, 20bps above threshold. September hike at ~54% is 16 points below the 70% formal trigger. Oil deflation has contributed most of its rate-relief. The path from 5.20% to 5.00% runs through: ADP July at 8:15 AM ET (consensus ~100K; June 98K) and NFP Friday (consensus ~91K). A soft ADP below 80K pushes September toward 45%; a sub-80K NFP has the path to compress the 30Y toward 5.00% by mid-August — the first 0-of-6 regime reading since before Iran escalation.
trade_setups.entry: Watch September hike probability within 30 minutes of ADP. Below 45% is an early signal toward clearing. The level that defines it: 30Y 5.00% is the invalidation of the sole breach; 5.28% is where the setup breaks upward and the clearing thesis stalls.
trade_setups.invalidation: ADP above 200K pushes September back toward 65%. ISM Services prices-paid above 65% at 10:00 AM ET indicates services inflation broadening regardless of labor.
trade_setups.horizon: ADP 8:15 AM ET today; NFP Friday August 7; 30Y resolution by mid-August.

trade_setups.asset: AMD post-earnings structure — $484 as the reset floor
trade_setups.thesis: AMD beat every Q2 consensus line and sold off 8% from an elevated pre-earnings entry. The structure: if $484 (Monday close, pre-PLTR-read-through) holds in the first two regular sessions, the washout absorbed the premium and the DC thesis is intact at a lower entry. Q3 conference call comments on gross margin trajectory are the deciding data. Above $484 through two regular closes: washout absorbed. Below $440 with volume: full premium retracement; thesis requires reassessment.
trade_setups.entry: The levels: $484 is the PLTR-read-through anchor; $440-450 is pre-AI-confirmation support; $510-520 is the next reference if $484 holds. First-day reactions are not the read.
trade_setups.invalidation: Q3 gross margin guidance below 55% on the call, or NVDA/custom-silicon displacement commentary — either suggests structural margin compression rather than a ramp cost.
trade_setups.horizon: 2-5 sessions for post-earnings structure; Q3 results in ~3 months for margin confirmation.

bear_case: The Hormuz deal has collapsed twice in 2026, and SPX at 7,737 has simultaneously priced the signing, labor softening, AI earnings strength, and oil deflation. Any IRGC action restores WTI $82+ in one session and returns both oil-side triggers. AMD's 54% gross margin may not be a temporary ramp cost: if Helios competitive pricing has moved the floor, the multiple compression is structural and reads through to NVDA's margin assumptions. SPCX's $18.37B quarterly capex at 2.35x revenue is VC-scale deployment in a public market; the payback period is unmeasurable. September hike remains above 50% on CME FedWatch, meaning the 30Y clearing trade is not consensus. If SPX closes below 7,380, this read no longer holds.
